subject: all construction = 動土
resolution: XJBF v11 explicitly distinguishes multiple construction/occupancy events.

subject: 動土 vs 破土
resolution: In XJBF民用 list, 修造動土 and 破土 are distinct; 破土 sits with burial events.

subject: 入宅
resolution: Use source terms 移徙/般移 in evidence layer; show 入宅 only as modern UI concept if mapping is declared.

subject: 安門 in XJBF
resolution: Do not cite XJBF v11 as direct independent 安門 rule.

subject: Yingzao Fashi 次序 vs auspicious date
resolution: Technical craft sequence is not calendrical selection.

subject: traditional selection contradictions
resolution: XJBF itself was compiled partly to correct contradictory/erroneous selection traditions; do not reconstruct a falsely unanimous tradition.

subject: 宅經 as Huangdi
resolution: May cite text; may not cite Huangdi as historical author.
